title: Personal gameplay pilot
question: How can timestamped observations and configuration records support reliable interaction annotation?
inclusion: Adult researcher documenting their own permitted gameplay; no participant recruitment.
measures: Event intervals, action completion, reported experience, missingness and annotation effort.
permittedMediaUse: Local annotation only. Optional reuse and ML processing require separate permission.
retention: Personal pilot: retain on this device until manually deleted; export backups under your control.
deletion: Delete sessions in the workspace and remove exported backups separately. Local files are never deleted by this app.
informationText: Draft personal-pilot information, not an institution-approved consent instrument. Participation is optional. Local data stays in this browser until you export or explicitly submit it. Do not include names, chat logs, voices or third-party identities without permission.
